name: London Project affiliate layout standard v6 - fixed reusable ten-product set
selection_principles: Each destination has its own fixed set of exactly ten Coupang Partners products.
Reuse the same ten products in the same order on every article until an operator deliberately replaces the catalog.
Do not perform per-article product search, random selection, image replacement, or rotation.
Each product must have one unique account-generated Coupang tracking URL and one unique official Coupang product image.
Render exactly three header buttons in this order: Trip.com, OLIVE YOUNG, Coupang Partners.
Trip.com and OLIVE YOUNG are header links only; the ten product cards are Coupang Partners only.
Use only the account's supplied affiliate URLs. Do not invent tracking links, image URLs, prices, sales, reviews, or commission rates.
Keep separate product catalogs and header links per destination; never share product pools across unrelated sites.
Preserve article body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the designated affiliate block.
Display the Coupang Partners commission disclosure with the product cards.
